ce within the specified timeline. Failure to submit such justification, the inability to provide at that price, or submission of an inadequate/unsatisfactory justification may result in the r ejection of the quoted item(s) and disqualification of the bid for that partic ular schedule or the entire tender, as deemed appropriate by the Compete nt Authority. The decision of the Evaluation Committee/Competent Authority in this rega rd shall be final and binding, and no further correspondence shall be entert ained. Clause 3: Rejection of Bids in Case of Identical IP Address In order to ensure transparency and fairness in the bidding process, it is hereby stipulated that if two or more bids are found to have been submitted from the s ame IP address, such bids shall be treated as non-compliant and shall be summ arily rejected without any further consideration. The decision of the Competent Authority in this regard shall be final and binding. Clause 4: Mandatory Submission of Compliance Sheet with Manufactur er Details To ensure authenticity and traceability of the materials, the seller shall provide a compliance sheet on the signed letterhead of the firm at the time of bid submission.
